summary: Retest of the Phase D-4 discovery red-screen fix in /app/frontend/app/admin/discovery.tsx. Verified the fix END-TO-END on the deployed preview (390x844 mobile viewport) with demo@amass.africa / amass2026. Result: 100% PASS on all 4 acceptance criteria from the review request. (1) /admin/discovery mounts cleanly with NO red-screen error — no 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading daily_cap_usd)' anywhere in DOM or console; only benign RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver). (2) Status card renders correctly: MOCK MODE chip visible, Today meter shows '$0.00 / $0.00', This Month meter shows '$0.00 / $0.00' (limits are 0 because backend is in mock mode with zero-cap defaults — expected), Key: — placeholder, and the 'New search' form (Text Search toggle + Query input pre-filled with 'lekki estate' + Discover button) renders below. (3) 'Pending duplicate review' section renders with count badge '2', containing the seeded candidate D4 UI Seed Bravo (id=7a762997-ddd4-47e4-996e-43c21e650c81, PENDING_DEDUPLICATION, SCORE 55, 0 matches) as well as Palm Grove Apartments (D-4 screenshot). Row testID `pending-7a762997-ddd4-47e4-996e-43c21e650c81` is present and tappable. (4) Tapping the Bravo row navigates the router to /admin/duplicate-review/7a762997-ddd4-47e4-996e-43c21e650c81, the admin-dup-review container mounts, the recommendation banner ('No duplicates detected · Top score: 0'), the candidate card (gold CANDIDATE chip + PENDING_DEDUPLICATION chip + name + address + PROPERTY meta chip + coords 6.43950, 3.47420 + premise/point_of_interest tags), the mini-map placeholder ('Interactive map available on mobile' — expected on web since react-native-maps has no web renderer, same behavior as iteration_23), and the primary 'Keep Separate — allow as new lead' button (testID btn-keep-separate) all render correctly. The fix (using AUTH_STORAGE_KEY from @/src/lib/api in _authHeaders + ?? 0 nullish fallbacks on Meter spent/cap props) fully resolves the D-4 entry-flow blocker documented in iteration_23. No new issues found.

rca_of_issue: Original bug (iteration_23) was caused by two independent issues in /app/frontend/app/admin/discovery.tsx: (a) inline `_authHeaders` read the wrong storage key `amass_auth_v1`, causing /api/admin/discovery/status to be called unauthenticated → 401 → throw; (b) Meter render read `status.limits.daily_cap_usd` without a nullish guard on the sub-object. E1's fix addresses both: dynamic import of AUTH_STORAGE_KEY constant from api.ts ensures the correct key `amass_auth_token` is used, and `?? 0` fallbacks on all four Meter props prevent partial-status render crashes. Verified by successful mount + all elements visible + no console errors related to the original crash.
